articles.title: Adverse Event Analysis
articles.requirement: Potentially adverse events are analysed to better characterise them.

articles.title: Information Correlation
articles.requirement: Information is correlated from multiple sources.

articles.title: Impact Estimation
articles.requirement: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood.

articles.title: Incident Identification
articles.requirement: Information on adverse events is provided to authorised staff and tools.

articles.title: Cyber Intelligence
articles.requirement: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis.

articles.title: Incidents Declared
articles.requirement: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria.

articles.title: Network Monitoring
articles.requirement: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

articles.title: Physical Environment
articles.requirement: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events.

articles.title: Personnel Activity
articles.requirement: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

articles.title: External Service Monitoring
articles.requirement: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

articles.title: Computing Hardware Monitoring
articles.requirement: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events.

articles.title: Organisational Context
articles.requirement: Organisational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management.

articles.title: Internal Stakeholders
articles.requirement: Internal stakeholders' cybersecurity risk management roles and responsibilities are established.

articles.title: Legal Requirements
articles.requirement: Legal, regulatory, and contractual cybersecurity requirements are understood and managed.

articles.title: Critical Objectives
articles.requirement: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that stakeholders depend on are established and communicated.

articles.title: Supply Chain Outcomes
articles.requirement: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organisation depends on are established and communicated.

articles.title: Cybersecurity Performance
articles.requirement: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction.

articles.title: Cybersecurity State Review
articles.requirement: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organisational requirements and risks.

articles.title: Organisational Cybersecurity Results
articles.requirement: Organisational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed.

articles.title: Policy Establishment
articles.requirement: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organisational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced.

articles.title: Policy Review
articles.requirement: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organisational mission.

articles.title: Risk Management Strategy
articles.requirement: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organisational stakeholders.

articles.title: Risk Appetite
articles.requirement: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained.

articles.title: Risk Integration
articles.requirement: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes.

articles.title: Strategic Direction
articles.requirement: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated.

articles.title: Lines of Communication
articles.requirement: Lines of communication across the organisation are established for cybersecurity risks.

articles.title: Policy Standards
articles.requirement: A standardised method for calculating, documenting, categorising, and prioritising cybersecurity risks is established.

articles.title: Strategic Opportunities
articles.requirement: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterised and are included in organisational cybersecurity risk discussions.

articles.title: Board Accountability
articles.requirement: Organisational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving.

articles.title: Roles and Responsibilities
articles.requirement: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced.

articles.title: Adequate Resources
articles.requirement: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies.

articles.title: Cybersecurity in HR
articles.requirement: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices.

articles.title: Supply Chain Risk Policy
articles.requirement: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management programme, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organisational stakeholders.

articles.title: Supply Chain Roles
articles.requirement: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally.

articles.title: Supply Chain Integration
articles.requirement: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes.

articles.title: Supplier Selection
articles.requirement: Suppliers are known and prioritised by criticality.

articles.title: Supplier Requirements
articles.requirement: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritised, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties.

articles.title: Supplier Monitoring
articles.requirement: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships.

articles.title: Supply Chain Incidents
articles.requirement: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritised, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship.

articles.title: Relevant Suppliers
articles.requirement: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities.

articles.title: Supply Chain Assurance
articles.requirement: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programmes, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle.

articles.title: Cybersecurity in Acquisitions
articles.requirement: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement.

articles.title: Hardware Inventory
articles.requirement: Inventories of hardware managed by the organisation are maintained.

articles.title: Software Inventory
articles.requirement: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organisation are maintained.

articles.title: Network Inventory
articles.requirement: Representations of the organisation's authorised network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained.

articles.title: External Systems
articles.requirement: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained.

articles.title: Assets Prioritised
articles.requirement: Assets are prioritised based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission.

articles.title: Data Inventory
articles.requirement: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained.

articles.title: System Lifecycle
articles.requirement: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles.

articles.title: Improvement Plans
articles.requirement: Improvements are identified from evaluations.

articles.title: Vulnerability Management
articles.requirement: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties.

articles.title: Execution of Improvements
articles.requirement: Identified improvements are prioritised and implemented based on risk.

articles.title: Incident Response Plans
articles.requirement: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved.

articles.title: Vulnerability Identification
articles.requirement: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.

articles.title: Threat Intelligence
articles.requirement: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.

articles.title: Threat Identification
articles.requirement: Internal and external threats to the organisation are identified and recorded.

articles.title: Potential Business Impacts
articles.requirement: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded.

articles.title: Risk Register
articles.requirement: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritisation.

articles.title: Risk Response
articles.requirement: Risk responses are chosen, prioritised, planned, tracked, and communicated.

articles.title: Risk Changes
articles.requirement: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked.

articles.title: Vulnerability Disclosure
articles.requirement: Processes for receiving, analysing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established.

articles.title: Hardware and Software Integrity
articles.requirement: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use.

articles.title: Critical Supplier Assessment
articles.requirement: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition.

articles.title: Identity Management
articles.requirement: Identities and credentials for authorised users, services, and hardware are managed by the organisation.

articles.title: Identity Proofing
articles.requirement: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions.

articles.title: Access Management
articles.requirement: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated.

articles.title: Identity Assertions
articles.requirement: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified.

articles.title: Access Permissions and Entitlements
articles.requirement: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorisations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties.

articles.title: Physical Access
articles.requirement: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk.

articles.title: Awareness Training
articles.requirement: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.

articles.title: Specialised Training
articles.requirement: Individuals in specialised roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.

articles.title: Data-at-Rest Protection
articles.requirement: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected.

articles.title: Data-in-Transit Protection
articles.requirement: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.

articles.title: Data-in-Use Protection
articles.requirement: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected.

articles.title: Backups
articles.requirement: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested.

articles.title: Network Integrity
articles.requirement: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorised logical access and usage.

articles.title: Environmental Protection
articles.requirement: The organisation's technology assets are protected from environmental threats.

articles.title: Computing Infrastructure
articles.requirement: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations.

articles.title: Adequate Capacity
articles.requirement: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained.

articles.title: Configuration Management
articles.requirement: Configuration management practices are established and applied.

articles.title: Software Maintenance
articles.requirement: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.

articles.title: Hardware Maintenance
articles.requirement: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.

articles.title: Log Records
articles.requirement: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring.

articles.title: Removal
articles.requirement: Installation and execution of unauthorised software are prevented.

articles.title: Secure Software Development
articles.requirement: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle.

articles.title: Recovery Communication
articles.requirement: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders.

articles.title: Public Communication
articles.requirement: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging.

articles.title: Recovery Plan
articles.requirement: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process.

articles.title: Recovery Strategy
articles.requirement: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritised, and performed.

articles.title: Backup Integrity Verification
articles.requirement: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration.

articles.title: Post-Incident Norms
articles.requirement: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms.

articles.title: Asset Restoration
articles.requirement: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed.

articles.title: Recovery Completion
articles.requirement: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed.

articles.title: Analysis of Incidents
articles.requirement: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident.

articles.title: Actions Documented
articles.requirement: Actions taken during an investigation are recorded, and the integrity and provenance of records are preserved.

articles.title: Incident Data Collection
articles.requirement: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved.

articles.title: Incident Magnitude
articles.requirement: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated.

articles.title: Internal Reporting
articles.requirement: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents in a timely manner.

articles.title: Information Sharing
articles.requirement: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders as authorised.

articles.title: Incident Response Execution
articles.requirement: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared.

articles.title: Incident Triage
articles.requirement: Incident reports are triaged and validated.

articles.title: Incident Categorisation
articles.requirement: Incidents are categorised and prioritised.

articles.title: Incident Escalation
articles.requirement: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed.

articles.title: Criteria for Termination
articles.requirement: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied.

articles.title: Incident Containment
articles.requirement: Incidents are contained.

articles.title: Incident Eradication
articles.requirement: Incidents are eradicated.
